headline: 일상에 싱그러움을
videoPrompt: Premium photoreal shampoo commercial, single five second shot. Preserve the exact reference green bottle, black pump, gold collar and label. No people or hands. In the first half second a foreground emerald leaf sweeps past the lens, revealing the bottle standing still on wet dark stone in a lush emerald forest, with warm shafts of sunlight, mist and rippling water. The camera starts at a medium distance then makes a powerful smooth forward dolly through foreground foliage toward the bottle during seconds 1 to 3. Strong parallax, exciting cinematic acceleration then smooth deceleration. The bottle itself stays stationary and upright, no rotation or deformation. By second 3 settle into a stable sharp hero close-up with the whole pump visible, bottle occupying the right half of the frame, about 75 percent of frame height. Hold this final composition for two seconds. Keep the left third dark and softly out of focus as clean negative space. Rich emerald shadows, sparkling droplets, warm rim lighting, premium beauty cinematography. No added text, captions, graphics, lettering, people, hands or duplicate products.
